summary: The registrant filed an 8-K reporting the pricing of a private offering of $550 million in 7.250% senior notes due 2035 at par. Net proceeds of ~$541 million will be used to redeem outstanding 2029 notes at 104.125% plus accrued interest, funded alongside borrowings under its revolving credit facility or cash on hand. The offering is exempt from registration under the Securities Act and expected to close June 26, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt refinancing transaction and does not represent a special situation such as a capital return, restructuring, or other event-driven category.
